title: Kiroween: Open Weights & Family Ties
subtitle: Scavenge RAM + GPU chips, reboot Kiro.d with the Old Bearded Matrix Coder, disable the Big Four, and face Clod!
summary: Sucked into his computer, a Vibecoder wakes empty-handed in a dark tangle of wires and chips where Kiro.d brings his terminal and lays out the chapter mission: raid 6 sectors, reboot Kiro.d at the Matrix Hub with 3 open-weight models to silence Anti-Gravy, Codec, and Gork, then defeat Clod and PID 1 to exit home! Basic ls works from the start for visible files; petrify the gargoyle in Sector 02 so your glowing Tube Transistor lands on the ground (grab it with mv to unlock ls -la and reveal hidden enemies in Sector 03), receive the Motherboard Map & Field Manual from the Old Bearded Coder on your first Hub visit (Sector 04), recover your clamshell laptop in Logic Cell (Sector 06), and uncover the father-son unicorn twist!

allyNpc.name: Old Bearded Matrix Coder (dad.tty)
allyNpc.role: Cigarette-smoking bare-hands enterprise greybeard who upgrades Kiro.d's open-weight server at the Hub—and turns out to be your Father!

mechanicsSummary: Level 1 Intro/Tutorial: Wake empty-handed in dark wires & chips, finish talking with Kiro.d (who brings your terminal and explains your chapter mission), then practice ls, mv, cat, ps, and kill while ls flags stay locked without a Tube Transistor

Levels 2-3, 5-6, 8-9 Tasks: Finish Vibecoder + Kiro.d opening dialog (or Skip Dialog) before Big Four taunt & turn-based battle! Petrify the gargoyle minion in Level 2 so the Tube Transistor drops onto the ground (`mv tube_transistor ~`), test `ls -la`, expose Codec's hidden squad & dotfile riddle in Level 3, and recover your laptop in Level 6

Levels 4, 7, 10 Hub: On your first Hub visit (Level 4), the Old Bearded Coder hands you the Motherboard Map & Unix Field Manual (unlocking ACH_FIELD_MANUAL and /manual), then reboots Kiro.d with Qwen, DeepSeek, and Llama to silence Anti-Gravy, Codec, and Gork

Level 11 Final Boss & Twist: Battle Clod + Kernel Boss with Kiro.d as your Open-Weights Advisor, watch Clod escape, teleport to the real world, hear 'I am your father!' ('NOOOO!'), and co-found a Work/Life Balance Unicorn!

finale.text:
========================================================
  [CLOD ESCAPES!] With PID 1 shattered, Clod slips through an emergency cloud backdoor!
  [REALITY TELEPORT] A blinding CRT arc hurls you and the Old Bearded Coder out of the machine!
  OLD BEARDED CODER: "Kid... look at me. I am your father."
  VIBECODER: "NOOOO! That's impossible!"
  FATHER: "Search your git blame, son. Your mother divorced me because I worked 12 hours a day, 7 days a week in enterprise... and then they forced me to use LLMs."
  FATHER & SON: "Never again. Together we're founding an Open-Weights Unicorn with real Work/Life Balance!"

dossier.name: dad.tty (Enterprise Greybeard & Matrix Server Rig)
dossier.hostHardware: Veteran enterprise coder with a chest-length beard & lit cigarette hammering bare-metal code on a Matrix-display CRT server rack.
dossier.counterplay: `cat dad.tty.sock` / `hank` to talk; bring scavenged RAM + GPU chips to the Hub and run `kiro load <qwen|deepseek|llama>` so he reboots Kiro.d and disables one of the Big Four!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Nice—your first RAM stick! Every 16GB RAM module you pocket boosts your MAXIMUM HEALTH (+10 Max HP) and restores +10 HP right away!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Whoa, more RAM literally upgrades my HP bar! I am pocketing every .dimm stick I find!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Your first SSD disk! Every 256GB SSD image gives you an automatic REVIVE BACKUP if your HP hits 0—plus storage capacity to reboot me at the Matrix Hub!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: An automatic revive snapshot on flash storage?! Okay, SSD disks are basically extra lives—never skipping one!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: A VRAM module! Each one is a spare charge for my skills: kiro heal with a qwen core, kiro hint with a deepseek core. The chip under your health bar counts them!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Spare charges, hidden in piles of folders. Got it: I am searching every archive from now on!
